reviews.shade: ongredients Skin Barrier Glow Mist Set (100ml+50ml)
reviews.text: Very awesome! It is very moisturizing before applying makeup and the makeup can be very comfortable. The best thing is that you do not take off your makeup all day!
reviews.zh: 好正！化妝之前用，保濕效果好好，妝都可以好舒服。最好嘅係成日都唔會脫妝！

reviews.shade: ongredients Skin Barrier Glow Mist Set (100ml+50ml)
reviews.text: Hydrates skin fast, only thing I wish the spray is finer, never the less is great product as always from Ongreidents!
reviews.zh: 保濕快，唯一希望噴霧可以更加幼細，話雖如此，一如以往都係 Ongreidents 嘅好產品！

reviews.shade: ongredients Skin Barrier Glow Mist Set (100ml+50ml)
reviews.text: Universal toner in a very convenient spray form for any skin type! I used the little bottle during the long flight and it kept my skin moisturised. I didn’t notice any specific glow after using it but my skin is so oily that I don’t need it.
reviews.zh: 全膚質都啱用嘅萬用化妝水，噴霧形式好方便！我坐長途飛機嗰陣用咗啲細樽裝，皮膚都保持到滋潤。用完之後我冇特別感覺到光澤，但係我皮膚好油，所以我唔需要佢。

reviews.shade: ongredients Skin Barrier Glow Mist Set (100ml+50ml)
reviews.text: It’s a moisturising mist. I have oily skin so it’s ok for me. Maybe good for people with dry skin. It’s good to spray on after or before to set make up
reviews.zh: 係一款保濕噴霧。我皮膚係油性，所以對我嚟講都OK。可能對乾性皮膚嘅人好。化妝前後噴一下嚟定妝都好。

reviews.shade: ongredients Skin Barrier Glow Mist Set (100ml+50ml)
reviews.text: Amazing - perfect for everyday use, is true to what is says it will do I would highly recommend to friends and family. The formula is divine and fells amazing on your skin.
reviews.zh: 非常好！日常使用都好完美，同佢所講嘅功效一致，我會極力推薦畀親朋戚友。配方好正，搽喺皮膚上感覺非常好。

reviews.shade: ongredients Skin Barrier Glow Mist Set (100ml+50ml)
reviews.text: Heard so many great things about this mist and I honestly thought it would have a heavy feeling to it like the cream mists. But it’s so lightweight and I can’t wait to use it under makeup!
reviews.zh: 聽過好多人讚呢款噴霧，我真係以為佢會好似乳霜型噴霧咁厚重。但係佢好輕盈，我好想快啲喺化妝底下用！

reviews.shade: ongredients Skin Barrier Glow Mist Set (100ml+50ml)
reviews.text: This product is incredibly hydrating and leaves the skin feeling soft and nourished. The packaging is very convenient and easy to use, which makes it perfect for daily routine. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable and effective product!
reviews.zh: 呢款產品保濕力非常強，令皮膚感覺柔軟、滋潤。包裝好方便易用，好適合日常使用。如果你想搵一款可靠又有效嘅產品，極力推薦！

reviews.shade: ongredients Skin Barrier Glow Mist Set (100ml+50ml)
reviews.text: Absolutely love this mist! It gives such a healthy, dewy glow without feeling greasy. It absorbs into the skin almost instantly and feels very gentle, which is great for my sensitive skin. Perfect for a quick hydration boost throughout the day or as a final step in my skincare routine. Highly recommend for the glow!
reviews.zh: 真係好鍾意呢款噴霧！佢令皮膚有健康、水潤嘅光澤，又唔會油膩。幾乎即刻被皮膚吸收，感覺好溫和，對我嘅敏感肌好好。好啱日間快速補濕，或者做護膚程序最後一步。為咗呢個光澤感，極力推薦！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
